blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) has established a bonded facility for imported Jet A-1 fuel for international flights, creating a mechanism for eligible carriers and fuel suppliers to avail of tax incentives under the CREATE MORE Act.
